workLog.task: Correct the existing pre-push ratchet advice in GOTCHAS.md
workLog.outcome: The documented check ran the four ratchet scripts. Measured on a pristine origin/main worktree: taste_count_ratchet.py prints OK at 594 <= 595 and exits 0, while tests/ci/test_count_ratchet_against_real_git.py::test_the_shipped_baseline_matches_the_tracked_tree fails on the same tree with assert 594 == 595. Added a section naming the script/test divergence, quoting the test docstring's dead-allowance rationale, and replacing the recommended check with the 3-second pytest invocation.

workLog.task: Record that merging main clears an inherited red
workLog.outcome: Measured on a branch whose diff was four files and no Python: 7 pre-push failures before git merge origin/main, 113 passed after, with the diff unchanged. Added the three-case discrimination table covering main's bug, a stale base, and your own bug.

workLog.task: Record that a merged commit's file count is not evidence about the local commit gate
workLog.outcome: Repository merge config is allow_merge_commit false, allow_rebase_merge false, allow_squash_merge true, and every commit on main is single-parent. GitHub builds squash commits server-side, so MAX_AUTHORED_FILES_PER_COMMIT never inspected them. This refuted a defect report drafted earlier in the session that cited 43-file and 71-file commits on main as evidence the gate was unsatisfiable.
